relationships.subject: cannabidiol
relationships.evidence_quote: the CBD (5, 10 and 30 μg/paw) induced the antinociception in a dosage-dependent manner

relationships.subject: SB-366791
relationships.evidence_quote: SB-366791 (16 μg/paw), a selective TRPV1 antagonist, partially reversed the CBD-induced antinociception

relationships.subject: NAN-190
relationships.evidence_quote: The administration of NAN-190 (10 μg/paw), a selective 5-HT1A receptor antagonist

key_findings: Peripheral CBD (30 ug/paw) produced local dose-dependent antinociception in sciatic nerve constriction neuropathy without systemic motor effects.
The 5-HT1A antagonist NAN-190 and TRPV1 antagonist SB-366791 partially reversed CBD antinociception.
